title: Testing Data Layer with @DataJpaTest
description: Test JPA repositories with an embedded database and slice tests.

slides.title: Slice Testing JPA 🗃️
slides.content:
# @DataJpaTest

This annotation configures an in‑memory database (by default H2), scans for `@Entity` classes and `@Repository` interfaces, and provides a `TestEntityManager` to interact with the database.

It does **not** load full Spring context – only JPA related components.

quizData.question: Which annotation is used to test Spring Data JPA repositories?
quizData.explanation: @DataJpaTest sets up a slice for JPA repositories with an embedded database.

slides.title: Repository Test Example
Rollback by Default
slides.content: Tests annotated with `@DataJpaTest` are transactional and rolled back after each test by default, keeping the database clean.
